Subject: Request: additional sandbox credits for upcoming bakeoff

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile on your dedicated routing options. We have a vendor RFP kickoff next month where we'll run side-by-side benchmarks (ClusterHealth + two incumbents) and we'd like to request a short-term sandbox/top-up allocation to ensure meaningful throughput in our tests.

Scope: 2-week bakeoff starting 2027-01-04, expected peak of ~60M tokens (generation + eval).
What we'd need: ~60k USD equivalent credits or a token allocation and a simple usage estimate so our procurement can justify.
Constraints: We cannot accept open-ended credits without an escrowed SOW or a usage cap and audit visibility.

Can you advise on what Redwood can offer under your bakeoff policy? We prefer a short contract or an LOE to speed procurement.

Thanks,
Ami
Ami Singh
Head of ML Platforms, ClusterHealth

Hi Ami — really glad the demo landed well. We can support a sandbox "bounty" for bakeoffs to make comparisons fair; a few quick notes and ask on our side: 

- Proposal: Redwood provides a capped credit allocation equivalent to $60k (token-based), active for a 2-week window (2027-01-04 to 2027-01-18).
- Requirements from ClusterHealth: a signed short-form SOW or PO referencing the bakeoff, an agreed usage cap, and a contact for weekly telemetry access so we can keep the allocation healthy.
- Escrow/guardrail: we prefer credits disbursed under an escrowed SOW with auto-reduction if usage exceeds the cap; if procurement needs a dollar invoice we can convert the credit into a discounted invoice line item.

I've sketched a short SOW and a rough usage estimate (attached) to speed things up. Can you confirm procurement's acceptance of an escrowable SOW + drive link for telemetry? If so I'll loop in Ops/Finance for approvals tomorrow.

Best,
